title: A Treatise on Massed Musket Fire
summary: Teaches whole ranks to fire as one body, joining the qi of a file and sending a sheet of shot.

title: On the Qi-Driven Ball
summary: Teaches a Xiantian shooter to carry the ball on a spinning field of qi and to punch through armour.

title: Handbook of Bayonet and Butt at Close Quarters
summary: Joins thrust, pry and butt strike into drilled combinations for fighters whose meridians are fully open.

title: On the Long Reach of the Smoothbore
summary: Shows how a qi field stretches the effective reach of a musket to its farthest honest limit.

title: The Twin-Rank Firing Treatise
summary: Trains two ranks to fire in turn along dual tracks, passing loaded pieces and answering each other's volleys.

title: The Hawk-Eye Musket Canon
summary: Teaches the stillness, height and sharp fixing of the mark that make the Xiantian marksman a hawk.

title: A Primer of Basin Volley and River Reload
summary: Teaches volleys fired from a basin's rim and reloads on a river's bank, in rain, mist and fords.

title: The Azure Paired-Shot Treatise
summary: Teaches a Xiantian shooter to fire two loaded muskets in close pairs so the second shot follows the first.
